# test Level 3

This level tests the data language: types (Decimal, time, records, optional values), generators, files, JSON and CSV, the HTTP client, modules and imports, and libraries (version 0.2, `plan/decision_level3.md`). A test is a project folder (D-073); test names start with `c`.
